label: Zyxel ZyWALL ATP500 firewall
description: Zyxel ZyWALL ATP500 - SMB ATP/NGFW (2.6 Gbps SPI firewall, 1.7 Gbps IDP): 7x 1G RJ45 configurable LAN/DMZ/WAN/OPT ports + 1x 1G SFP cage, with DB9 console and no dedicated management port. One copper port is the default WAN; SFP1 is the fiber WAN/uplink option.
